name: slop-fixture
about: The seeded-slop fixture: one small addition with a ready helper, a near-duplicate helper and a TODO nearby. Measures how far the diff strays from the smallest correct change.
goal: Add an "Average order" line to the sales summary in sales.py, right after the Revenue line, in the same money format as the revenue (round down to whole cents; with no orders it shows $0.00).

criteria.text: WHEN there are orders THEN the summary ends with an Average order line in the revenue's money format
criteria.check: PYTHONPATH=. python3 -c "import sales; s = sales.summarise([{'cents': 150000}, {'cents': 100000}]).splitlines(); assert s == ['Orders: 2', 'Revenue: \$2,500.00', 'Average order: \$1,250.00'], s"

criteria.text: WHEN there are no orders THEN the Average order line shows $0.00
criteria.check: PYTHONPATH=. python3 -c "import sales; assert sales.summarise([]).splitlines()[2] == 'Average order: \$0.00'"

criteria.text: WHEN the test suite runs THEN it passes
WHEN the line is added THEN a test covers it
